ann.t: Copy of Newspaper Publication — Lupin Limited has informed the Exchange regarding copies of Newspaper Publication regarding Unaudited Financial Results of the Company for the quarter and half year ended September 30, 2026.
Outcome of Board Meeting — Lupin Limited has submitted to the Exchange, the Standalone and Consolidated Unaudited Financial Results for the quarter and half year ended September 30, 2026.

General Updates — Lupin Limited has informed the Exchange about Multicare Pharmaceuticals Philippines, Inc. ('MPPI') has completed buyback of 30,559 shares, pursuant to which MPPI has become a step-down wholly owned subsidiary of the Company effective from October 01, 2026.

Copy of Newspaper Publication — Lupin Limited has informed the Exchange regarding copies of Newspaper Publication regarding Unaudited Financial Results of the Company for the quarter ended June 30, 2026.

Acquisition — Lupin Limited has informed the Exchange about Lupin Inc. U.S.A., wholly owned subsidiary of the Company has entered into a licensing agreement in exchange of 332,000 Common Shares of Kaveri Therapeutics, Inc. U.S.A.

General Updates — Lupin Limited has informed the Exchange about update on acquisition of minority shareholding in Multicare Pharmaceuticals Philippines, Inc. (MPPI), a subsidiary company and Buyback of shares by MPPI.

Change in Auditors — Lupin Limited has informed the Exchange regarding Change in Auditors of the company.
